verdict.rationale: Databricks hosts an llms.txt file (probe confirms HTTP 200 with a structured documentation index) and also ships agent-oriented skill docs (SKILL.md files installable via `databricks aitools install`) that agents can be pointed at, going beyond a bare llms.txt. missing for 10: no independent third-party report of an agent successfully consuming llms.txt or the skills in practice, and no evidence of an /llms-full.txt or deeper machine-readable agent doc index.
